beats.summary: Dwight confronts Michael about not being interviewed for the manager position despite being qualified.

evidence.snippet: Dwight: I want to be manager. I just don't understand why I wasn't even interviewed for the job.
Dwight: That's because I'm your right-hand man, Michael, but I can't do it again. I can't do it again for a whole new guy.

beats.summary: Deangelo discusses portion control and calorie intake, leading to lighthearted office banter.

evidence.snippet: Deangelo: I do a lot of portion control. I try to keep my daily calor intake under 1200.
Stanley: Deangelo, you're going to starve to death.

beats.summary: Deangelo suggests changes to phone greeting style, encouraging Erin to try a new approach.

evidence.snippet: Deangelo: Why do you use your name when you use the phone?
Erin: Oh, that's how Pam does it. I just copy her.

beats.summary: Deangelo introduces a barber to the office and participates in a shaving session with Michael and Erin.

evidence.snippet: Deangelo: Ok, alright! I love it! I love it! Michael, this is Reggie. He is the #1 yelp reviewed shaver in Scranton.
Michael: And this is Erin and she is going to shave my face.

beats.summary: Deangelo asks the office staff for honest feedback on how he can be a better manager.

evidence.snippet: Oscar: Well, Deangelo, I'd say communication could be improved.

beats.summary: Andy attempts to tell a joke but struggles, leading to humorous moments including a collapsing table.

evidence.snippet: Andy: I wrote the perfect joke. Topical, edgy, funny.
Deangelo (laughter): Now that's funny! That's funny! You walk much?
